"""按Git clean语义核对全部起点报告、旧测试和共享核心边界。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
STARTS = {
    ROOT: 'a1b9b0989a3bf9267919675d83f2688dd6b275a5',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl007-windows\Cloudleaf'): '7f581dfca43515105fca918ffd79e55f315f7729',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl008-search\Cloudleaf'): '08b09277d3beeb90e284145a3423b9f00eca8d6c',
    Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl009-data\Cloudleaf'): 'c21db7ca70e5f51f84ca8bd30944d6722473c32c',
}


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root)


results = []
for root, start in STARTS.items():
    reports = git(root, 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', start, 'docs/reports').decode().splitlines()
    changed = git(root, 'diff', '--name-only', start, '--', *reports).decode().splitlines()
    assert not changed, (str(root), changed)
    deleted = git(root, 'diff', '--diff-filter=D', '--name-only', start, '--', 'crates', 'tests', 'adapters').decode().splitlines()
    assert not deleted, (str(root), deleted)
    protected = {}
    for name in ['data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv', 'tests/fixtures/input-v1.tsv', 'tests/evaluation/algorithm-v1.tsv']:
        path = root / name
        assert git(root, 'hash-object', '--path=' + name, str(path)).strip() == git(root, 'rev-parse', start + ':' + name).strip()
        protected[name] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    core_changes = git(root, 'diff', '--name-only', start, '--', 'crates/cloudleaf-input', 'crates/cloudleaf-types',
                       'crates/cloudleaf-pinyin', 'crates/cloudleaf-dictionary', 'crates/cloudleaf-candidate', 'apps/cloudleaf-cli').decode().splitlines()
    allowed = ['crates/cloudleaf-input/tests/round6_shared_review.rs'] if root == ROOT else []
    assert all(path in allowed for path in core_changes), (str(root), core_changes)
    results.append({'root': str(root), 'baseline_sha': start, 'head': git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip(),
                    'historical_reports_checked': len(reports), 'historical_reports_changed': changed,
                    'old_core_test_files_deleted': deleted, 'shared_core_changes': core_changes,
                    'allowed_shared_review_additions': allowed, 'protected_disk_resource_sha256': protected})
print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'scope': 'Git clean/path preservation and deletion check; no semantic or product acceptance claim',
                  'directions': results}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import io

B = Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl008-search\Cloudleaf')


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def blobs(root, revision, paths):
    command = ''.join(revision + ':' + path + '\n' for path in paths).encode('utf-8')
    stream = io.BytesIO(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=root, input=command))
    result = {}
    for path in paths:
        header = stream.readline().decode().strip().split()
        assert len(header) == 3 and header[1] == 'blob', (path, header)
        result[path] = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        assert stream.read(1) == b'\n'
    assert not stream.read()
    return result

"""将本轮共享检查原文无损封装，另留便于阅读的规范换行展示件。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / '.local/round6-shared-final-checks'
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round6-shared'
if OUT.exists():
    tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--', str(OUT)], cwd=ROOT)
    assert not tracked, '不覆盖已提交的历史证据'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save_json(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


raw_logs = {}
raw_artifacts = {}
files = []
for source in sorted(SOURCE.rglob('*')):
    if not source.is_file():
        continue
    name = source.relative_to(SOURCE).as_posix()
    data = source.read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    if source.suffix == '.log':
        raw_logs[name] = {'sha256': digest(data), 'bytes': len(data), 'utf8': text}
        target = OUT / (name[:-4] + '.txt')
        display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()).rstrip()
        if display:
            display += '\n'
        target.write_text(display, encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    else:
        raw_artifacts[name] = {'sha256': digest(data), 'bytes': len(data), 'utf8': text}
        target = OUT / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if source.suffix == '.json':
            save_json(target, json.loads(text))
        else:
            target.write_bytes(data)
    files.append({'original': name, 'original_bytes': len(data), 'original_sha256': digest(data),
                  'published': target.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(),
                  'published_sha256': digest(target.read_bytes())})

save_json(OUT / 'raw-logs.json', raw_logs)
save_json(OUT / 'raw-artifacts.json', raw_artifacts)
baseline_ci = json.loads((ROOT / '.local/round6-baseline-ci.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
save_json(OUT / 'baseline-ci.json', baseline_ci)
save_json(OUT / 'provenance.json', {
    'published_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'tested_head': json.loads((SOURCE / 'validation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['head'],
    'publication_parent': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip(),
    'raw_encoding': 'UTF-8; text re-encode to UTF-8 recovers original bytes; SHA256 recorded per log',
    'display_policy': 'log display strips trailing whitespace and normalizes LF; raw-logs.json preserves originals',
    'files': files,
})
print(json.dumps({'published': str(OUT), 'files': len(files), 'raw_logs': len(raw_logs)}))

"""在新目录保存共享分支README检查，所有原始输出与返回码独立保留。"""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round6-shared-checks'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
commands = [
    ['rustc', '--version'], ['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked'],
    ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py'],
    [sys.executable, 'scripts/benchmark.py', '--iterations', '1000', '--output', str(OUT / 'performance.json')],
    [sys.executable, 'scripts/evaluate_algorithms.py', '--output-dir', str(OUT / 'algorithm-v1')],
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
]
checks = []
for number, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    if command[0] in {'cargo', 'rustc', 'git'}:
        command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    log = OUT / f'command-{number:02}.log'
    log.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    row = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - begin, 'log': log.name}
    checks.append(row)
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
(OUT / 'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head': head, 'checks': checks}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
sys.exit(0 if all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in checks) else 1)

"""从真实Git树保存PR基线差异、共享接口一致性及非破坏性合并预览。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round6-shared-review'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def save(name, value):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


main = 'a564fd47b0f054ff360592af3ccb8d744021160f'
shared = 'a1b9b0989a3bf9267919675d83f2688dd6b275a5'
current = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
critical = ['crates/cloudleaf-input/src/lib.rs', 'crates/cloudleaf-types/src/lib.rs', 'scripts/check_workspace.py']
reviewed = []
for path in critical:
    content = git('show', shared + ':' + path)
    assert content == git('show', current + ':' + path), path
    reviewed.append({'path': path, 'baseline_git_blob': git('rev-parse', shared + ':' + path).decode().strip(),
                     'sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()})
records = []
for label, head in [('shared', shared), ('CL-007', '7f581dfca43515105fca918ffd79e55f315f7729'),
                    ('CL-008', '08b09277d3beeb90e284145a3423b9f00eca8d6c'),
                    ('CL-009', 'c21db7ca70e5f51f84ca8bd30944d6722473c32c')]:
    base = main if label == 'shared' else git('merge-base', shared, head).decode().strip()
    diff = git('diff', '--name-status', base, head).decode('utf-8')
    record = {'direction': label, 'reviewed_head': head, 'merge_base_with_shared': base,
              'name_status': diff, 'diff_stat': git('diff', '--stat', base, head).decode('utf-8')}
    if label != 'shared':
        record['core_git_blobs_equal_shared'] = {
            path: git('rev-parse', shared + ':' + path) == git('rev-parse', head + ':' + path)
            for path in ['crates/cloudleaf-input/src/lib.rs', 'crates/cloudleaf-types/src/lib.rs']}
        result = subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-tree', '--write-tree', '--messages', current, head], cwd=ROOT,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        record['merge_preview'] = {'command': ['git', 'merge-tree', '--write-tree', '--messages', current, head],
                                   'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'),
                                   'stderr': result.stderr.decode('utf-8'),
                                   'scope': 'Temporary Git tree objects only; no branch/worktree mutation, no integration acceptance'}
    records.append(record)
checks = []
commands = [['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'cloudleaf-input', '--test', 'round6_shared_review', '--locked', '--offline'],
            ['git', 'diff', '--check']]
for command in commands:
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    checks.append({'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                   'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), 'raw_utf8': result.stdout.decode('utf-8')})
save('review.json', {'reviewed_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'tested_head': current,
                      'critical_source_identities': reviewed, 'pr_diffs': records, 'checks': checks,
                      'new_shared_production_defect_reproduced': False,
                      'limitations': ['No cross-thread COM or real TSF acceptance here.', 'New independent regression passes old production; not a fabricated red/green fix.']})
assert all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in checks)
print(json.dumps({'head': current, 'critical': len(reviewed),
                  'preview': [(row['direction'], row.get('merge_preview', {}).get('returncode')) for row in records]}))

"""只读核对C方向发布字节、真实源位置和既有包，不改变方向证据。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf')
C = Path(r'C:\Users\EDY\.codex\worktrees\cl009-data\Cloudleaf')
PREFIX = 'docs/reports/cl009/round6/'
OUT = ROOT / '.local/audit_round6_c_independent.json'


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=C)


def published(name):
    return git('show', ':' + PREFIX + name)


head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
manifest = json.loads(published('checksums.json'))['files']
for name, expected in manifest.items():
    assert sha(published(name)) == expected, name
raw_files = json.loads(published('raw-artifacts.json'))['files']
for name, row in raw_files.items():
    raw = row['utf8'].encode('utf-8')
    assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row['sha256'], name
    assert Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes() == raw, name
checks = json.loads(published('checks.json'))
assert checks['implementation_commit'] == 'cdc73515ad5356844f1df4fc3ee30194c5a15ab6'
assert len(checks['checks']) == 10 and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in checks['checks'])
rust = next(row for row in checks['checks'] if row['command'][1:4] == ['test', '--workspace', '--all-targets'])
rust_count = sum(int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', rust['stdout']))
assert rust_count == 60
python = next(row for row in checks['checks'] if 'unittest' in row['command'])
assert re.search(r'Ran 83 tests.*?\bOK\b', python['stderr'], re.S)
diagnostics = json.loads(published('diagnostics.json'))
expected_codes = {'source-graph-a': 0, 'source-graph-b': 0, 'pending-audit': 2,
                  'pending-freeze': 1, 'wikipedia-gate': 2, 'old-package-verify': 0,
                  'archived-python-regression': 0, 'prototype': 0, 'old-seeds': 0}
assert len(diagnostics['checks']) == len(expected_codes)
for row in diagnostics['checks']:
    assert row['returncode'] == row['expected_returncode'] == expected_codes[row['name']]

identity = json.loads(published('identity.json'))
local = C / '.local/round6-diagnostics-cdc7351'
assert sha((local / 'source.zip').read_bytes()) == identity['archive_sha256']
source = C / '.local/data-sources/zhwiktionary-prefix-8388608.jsonl'
assert sha(source.read_bytes()) == identity['source_data_sha256']
lock = C / 'data/sources/locks/wiktionary-zh-20261001-prefix8388608.json'
assert sha(lock.read_bytes()) == identity['source_lock_file_sha256']
assert len(identity['source_graph_files']) == 5
for name, row in identity['source_graph_files'].items():
    raw = (local / 'graph-a' / name).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row['sha256']
    assert raw == (local / 'graph-b' / name).read_bytes(), name

lines = source.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
records = [json.loads(row) for row in (local / 'graph-a/assertions.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
lookup = json.loads((local / 'graph-a/lookup.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
senses = 0
translations = {}
for row in records:
    raw = lines[row['source']['line_number'] - 1]
    original = json.loads(raw)
    assert sha(raw) == row['source']['line_sha256']
    assert original['word'] == row['word'] and original.get('pos') == row['pos']
    assert row['frequency'] is None
    for sense in row['senses']:
        actual = original['senses'][int(sense['source_pointer'].split('/')[-1])]
        assert actual.get('glosses', []) == sense['glosses'] and actual.get('tags', []) == sense['tags']
        senses += 1
    for translation in row['translations']:
        actual = original['translations'][int(translation['source_pointer'].split('/')[-1])]
        assert actual['word'] == translation['word'] and actual['lang_code'] == 'en'
        assert actual.get('sense') == translation['source_sense_label'] and translation['sense_id'] is None
        key = translation['id']
        assert key not in translations
        translations[key] = (row['word'], translation['word'])
        assert lookup['zh_to_en'][row['word']].count(key) == lookup['en_to_zh'][translation['word']].count(key) == 1
assert (len(records), senses, len(translations)) == (591, 887, 241)
for name in ['zh_to_en', 'en_to_zh']:
    assert {key for group in lookup[name].values() for key in group} == set(translations)
assert lookup['reverse_lookup_creates_reverse_assertions'] is False
graph = json.loads((local / 'graph-a/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert graph['research_only'] and not graph['production_language_validated']
assert graph['source_lines'] == len(lines) == 66593
assert graph['entries'] + graph['quarantined_entries'] + graph['outside_scope'] + graph['missing_explicit_pinyin'] == len(lines)

old = C / '.local/round5-clean-6d3d4e1/release-a'
assert len(identity['old_package_files']) == 9
for name, expected in identity['old_package_files'].items():
    assert sha((old / name).read_bytes()) == expected, name
quality = json.loads((old / 'quality.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['counts']
assert quality['accepted_records'] == 123544 and quality['rejected_records'] == 1468
assert quality['missing_frequency'] == 123544
packet = json.loads((C / 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(packet['tasks']) == 12 and all(row['status'] == 'pending' for row in packet['tasks'])
assert all(not row[key] for row in packet['tasks'] for key in ['acceptable_outputs', 'author_id', 'input_intent', 'pinyin', 'reviews', 'key_trace'])
pending = json.loads(published('pending-audit.json'))
wiki = json.loads(published('wikipedia-gate.json'))
assert not pending['formal_language_ready'] and not pending['structurally_ready']
assert all(pending[name] is None for name in ['top1', 'top5', 'mrr'])
assert wiki['revision_identity_valid'] and not wiki['statistical_use_ready']
assert all(wiki[name] is None for name in ['token_frequency', 'document_frequency', 'zipf'])
history = json.loads(published('history-integrity.json'))
assert history['historical_reports_unchanged'] == 79 and not history['old_tests_deleted'] and not history['production_changes']
result = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'observed_head': head,
          'publication_identity': 'Git index bytes; manifest inspected during publication',
          'implementation_commit': checks['implementation_commit'], 'git_blob_sha256_verified': len(manifest),
          'original_utf8_artifacts_reconstructed_and_compared': len(raw_files), 'full_checks_returncodes': [0] * 10,
          'rust_tests': rust_count, 'python_tests': 83, 'diagnostic_expected_returncodes': expected_codes,
          'source_graph_double_build_files_checked': 5, 'source_pointer_records_checked': len(records),
          'source_senses_checked': senses, 'source_translation_pointers_and_both_indexes_checked': len(translations),
          'source_data_sha256': identity['source_data_sha256'], 'archive_sha256': identity['archive_sha256'],
          'source_graph_files': identity['source_graph_files'], 'old_package_files_checked': len(identity['old_package_files']),
          'old_runtime_records': quality['accepted_records'], 'old_quarantined_records': quality['rejected_records'],
          'old_frequency_unknown_records': quality['missing_frequency'], 'actual_pending_tasks': len(packet['tasks']),
          'real_human_gold_delivered': False, 'formal_language_quality_valid': False,
          'statistical_use_ready': False, 'language_truth_independently_verified': False,
          'findings': [], 'limits': ['未执行新构建或物理断电；验证既有原字节和真实源定位，不证明授权真实性或语言事实。']}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

"""按暂存Git字节和本机原件核验共享证据，保留原实现身份。"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round6-shared'


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def indexed(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', ':' + path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()], cwd=ROOT)


logs = json.loads((OUT / 'raw-logs.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
artifacts = json.loads((OUT / 'raw-artifacts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
provenance = json.loads((OUT / 'provenance.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert provenance['tested_head'] == 'ce2c16e8f53da9913f2624675c7807d07c044877'
for row in provenance['files']:
    raw = (logs | artifacts)[row['original']]
    data = raw['utf8'].encode('utf-8')
    assert len(data) == raw['bytes'] == row['original_bytes']
    assert sha(data) == raw['sha256'] == row['original_sha256']
    assert (ROOT / '.local/round6-shared-final-checks' / row['original']).read_bytes() == data
    assert sha(indexed(OUT / row['published'])) == row['published_sha256'], row['published']
validation = json.loads(indexed(OUT / 'validation.json'))
assert validation['head'] == provenance['tested_head']
assert len(validation['checks']) == 12 and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in validation['checks'])
for path in [OUT / 'raw-logs.json', OUT / 'raw-artifacts.json', OUT / 'direction-artifacts.json',
             OUT / 'independent-review.json', OUT / 'peer-review.json', OUT / 'runners.json',
             OUT / 'harness-preparation-failures.json', ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round6-ci.json']:
    json.loads(indexed(path))
ci = json.loads(indexed(ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007-009-round6-ci.json'))
for key in ['A', 'B', 'C']:
    row = ci[key]
    run, jobs, artifacts = row['run'], row['jobs']['jobs'], row['artifacts']['artifacts']
    assert run['event'] == 'push' and run['conclusion'] == 'success'
    assert len(jobs) == 2 and all(job['head_sha'] == run['head_sha'] and job['conclusion'] == 'success' for job in jobs)
    assert all(step['conclusion'] in ['success', 'skipped'] for job in jobs for step in job['steps'])
    assert len(artifacts) == 2 and all(not item['expired'] and item['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == run['head_sha'] and item['digest'] for item in artifacts)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'ce2c16e', '--', 'crates', 'apps', 'scripts', 'tests', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=ROOT)
print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'shared_original_files': len(provenance['files']),
                  'checks': len(validation['checks']), 'direction_ci_verified': 3,
                  'tested_implementation_unchanged': True}))
